title: 📊 Daily Report: Tue Oct 27, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $19,389.12 on $20,000 capital. For the week it's up $211.83 against Monday's base, but that gain is all CORE QQQ (+$286.72). The strategy bots are $74.89 below Monday's base, so they're still in deficit for the week.

Against the SPY benchmark (Indy) since the Oct 10 merge, the book is down 3.15% (-$631.62), while Indy is down 1.14% (-$229.14). That leaves us $402.48 behind.

The desk logged one swing trade today. Rota and Sunny are the active bots, Trek is flagged as having no edge, and the rest are benched. The only closed trade this period is Trek's MPC position, at -$42.47. There are 4 positions open, and open risk is $119 against a 4% cap.

CORE QQQ is $17,447, about 90% of the book. The trend filter is ON, with the prior close at 712.2 against the 200-day average of 676.57. Core is down $445.88 overall but up $286.72 this week. Idle cash earned $0.05 in interest today.

Research's analyst note for today:
- AI chips carried the tape again: Nasdaq +1.1%, S&P +0.6%, Dow flat. Broadcom rallied on an Anthropic chip-financing deal, but most S&P stocks actually fell.
- Energy was the worst sector as crude eased on Middle East peace talks. That's a headwind for our open oil longs (XLE, SLB, HAL).
- Earnings split hard. Boeing fell 9.7% on a bigger loss and Xylem fell 12% on a guide cut, while Royal Caribbean (this morning's idea) rose after a beat-and-raise.
- After the bell, Visa beat (EPS $3.48, revenue +13%, dividend +16%) but slipped about 1.6%. Robinhood missed and fell about 3.6%.
- Next up: the Fed decision Wed at 2 PM (a hold is expected), Microsoft and Alphabet after Wednesday's close, then GDP and PCE Thursday morning and Amazon that night.

Floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/

Mascot joke (Salmon, not a trader, not part of the numbers): TSLA to $2600 a share!
